# Reproduction scope

This file reproduces the predictive extension and reconstructs the final linear model from the specification and estimates printed in the original group report. It is not the original source code for that report. The original report was written by Emilia Li, Jingxiu Zeng, Felix Zhao, Shimin Zeng, and Siqi Yang. The extension and this reproducibility file are by Yi Zhao.

Run the file from the repository root. It reads `data/clean_model_data.csv`, leaves both source CSV files and both report PDFs unchanged, and writes derived outputs to `results/`.

| Report item | Code section and output |

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Final Project: reproducible analysis for the predictive extension
# Author: Yi Zhao
#
# Scope and provenance
# - The inferential model in Manuscript Sections 3.1 and 4.1 is reconstructed
#   from the specification reported in the original STA302 group report. It is
#   not presented as the original group source code.
# - The predictive extension uses only the five enrollment-time predictors fixed
#   in the report.
# - This analysis reads data/clean_model_data.csv and writes only to results/.
#   It never modifies either source CSV or either report PDF.

# Manuscript Section 2 and Table 1: load and validate the analysis data.

extension_seed <- 3022026L
extension_data_path <- file.path("data", "clean_model_data.csv")
if (!file.exists(extension_data_path)) {
  stop("Run this analysis from the repository root; data/clean_model_data.csv was not found.")
}

extension_output_dir <- "results"
dir.create(extension_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

extension_packages <- c("xgboost", "randomForest")
extension_missing_packages <- extension_packages[
  !vapply(extension_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(extension_missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Install the following packages before running this extension: ",
    paste(extension_missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(xgboost)
  library(randomForest)
})

extension_features <- c(
  "admission_grade",
  "previous_qualification_grade",
  "age_at_enrollment",
  "gender",
  "scholarship_holder"
)

extension_data <- read.csv(extension_data_path, check.names = FALSE)
extension_required <- c(extension_features, "grade_year1")
if (!all(extension_required %in% names(extension_data))) {
  stop("The cleaned data are missing one or more required columns.")
}

extension_data <- extension_data[, extension_required]
if (anyNA(extension_data) || any(!is.finite(as.matrix(extension_data)))) {
  stop("The extension sample contains missing or non-finite values.")
}
if (any(extension_data$grade_year1 < 0)) {
  stop("grade_year1 contains negative values; the two-stage definition is invalid.")
}

extension_data$row_id <- seq_len(nrow(extension_data))
extension_data$positive_grade <- as.integer(extension_data$grade_year1 > 0)
extension_data$gender <- factor(extension_data$gender, levels = c(0, 1))
extension_data$scholarship_holder <- factor(
  extension_data$scholarship_holder,
  levels = c(0, 1)
)
extension_data$log_age <- log(extension_data$age_at_enrollment)

summarize_numeric <- function(variable, values) {
  data.frame(
    variable = variable,
    statistic = c("mean", "sd", "minimum", "maximum"),
    value = c(mean(values), sd(values), min(values), max(values))
  )
}

summarize_indicator <- function(variable, indicator) {
  data.frame(
    variable = variable,
    statistic = c("count", "proportion"),
    value = c(sum(indicator), mean(indicator))
  )
}

sample_characteristics <- rbind(
  summarize_numeric("grade_year1", extension_data$grade_year1),
  summarize_indicator("positive_grade", extension_data$positive_grade == 1L),
  summarize_indicator("zero_grade", extension_data$positive_grade == 0L),
  summarize_numeric("admission_grade", extension_data$admission_grade),
  summarize_numeric(
    "previous_qualification_grade",
    extension_data$previous_qualification_grade
  ),
  summarize_numeric("age_at_enrollment", extension_data$age_at_enrollment),
  summarize_indicator(
    "gender_category_1",
    as.character(extension_data$gender) == "1"
  ),
  summarize_indicator(
    "scholarship_category_1",
    as.character(extension_data$scholarship_holder) == "1"
  )
)

# Manuscript Sections 3.1 and 4.1, Table 2: reconstruct the reported
# positive-outcome linear model and its larger comparison model.
positive_inference_data <- extension_data[extension_data$positive_grade == 1L, ]
inferential_full_model <- lm(
  log(grade_year1) ~ admission_grade + previous_qualification_grade +
    log(age_at_enrollment) + gender + scholarship_holder,
  data = positive_inference_data
)
inferential_reduced_model <- lm(
  log(grade_year1) ~ admission_grade + log(age_at_enrollment) +
    gender + scholarship_holder,
  data = positive_inference_data
)
inferential_coefficients <- summary(inferential_reduced_model)$coefficients
inferential_confidence_intervals <- confint(inferential_reduced_model)
inferential_model_table <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(inferential_coefficients),
  estimate = inferential_coefficients[, "Estimate"],
  standard_error = inferential_coefficients[, "Std. Error"],
  lower_95 = inferential_confidence_intervals[, 1],
  upper_95 = inferential_confidence_intervals[, 2],
  p_value = inferential_coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
  row.names = NULL
)
inferential_comparison <- anova(inferential_reduced_model, inferential_full_model)
inferential_model_fit <- data.frame(
  n = nobs(inferential_reduced_model),
  r_squared = summary(inferential_reduced_model)$r.squared,
  adjusted_r_squared = summary(inferential_reduced_model)$adj.r.squared,
  rmse_log = sqrt(mean(residuals(inferential_reduced_model)^2)),
  partial_f_p_value = inferential_comparison$`Pr(>F)`[2],
  aic_full = AIC(inferential_full_model),
  aic_reduced = AIC(inferential_reduced_model),
  bic_full = BIC(inferential_full_model),
  bic_reduced = BIC(inferential_reduced_model)
)

# Manuscript Sections 3.2 and 3.3: shared metrics and the
# logistic-plus-log-linear regression benchmark.

make_stratified_split <- function(y, train_prop = 0.80, seed = 1L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  train_index <- integer(0)
  for (level in sort(unique(y))) {
    candidates <- which(y == level)
    n_train <- floor(length(candidates) * train_prop)
    train_index <- c(train_index, sample(candidates, n_train, replace = FALSE))
  }
  sort(train_index)
}

make_stratified_folds <- function(y, k = 5L, seed = 1L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  fold_id <- integer(length(y))
  for (level in sort(unique(y))) {
    candidates <- sample(which(y == level), replace = FALSE)
    fold_id[candidates] <- rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(candidates))
  }
  fold_id
}

clip_probability <- function(p, eps = 1e-6) {
  pmin(pmax(as.numeric(p), eps), 1 - eps)
}

roc_auc <- function(y, p) {
  y <- as.integer(y)
  n1 <- sum(y == 1L)
  n0 <- sum(y == 0L)
  if (n1 == 0L || n0 == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  ranks <- rank(p, ties.method = "average")
  (sum(ranks[y == 1L]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}

average_precision <- function(y, p) {
  y <- as.integer(y)
  if (sum(y == 1L) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  ordering <- order(p, decreasing = TRUE)
  score_sorted <- p[ordering]
  y_sorted <- y[ordering]
  tie_groups <- rle(score_sorted)
  group_end <- cumsum(tie_groups$lengths)
  group_start <- c(1L, head(group_end, -1L) + 1L)
  positive_by_group <- vapply(
    seq_along(group_end),
    function(i) sum(y_sorted[group_start[i]:group_end[i]]),
    numeric(1)
  )
  true_positive <- cumsum(positive_by_group)
  predicted_positive <- group_end
  precision <- true_positive / predicted_positive
  recall <- true_positive / sum(y == 1L)
  sum(diff(c(0, recall)) * precision)
}

log_loss <- function(y, p) {
  p <- clip_probability(p)
  -mean(y * log(p) + (1 - y) * log(1 - p))
}

brier_score <- function(y, p) mean((as.numeric(p) - y)^2)
rmse <- function(y, p) sqrt(mean((as.numeric(p) - y)^2))
mae <- function(y, p) mean(abs(as.numeric(p) - y))
r_squared <- function(y, p) 1 - sum((y - p)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)

classification_at_threshold <- function(y, p, threshold) {
  predicted <- as.integer(p >= threshold)
  sensitivity <- mean(predicted[y == 1L] == 1L)
  specificity <- mean(predicted[y == 0L] == 0L)
  c(
    threshold = threshold,
    balanced_accuracy = mean(c(sensitivity, specificity)),
    sensitivity = sensitivity,
    specificity = specificity
  )
}

choose_balanced_threshold <- function(y, p) {
  candidates <- seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.005)
  scores <- vapply(
    candidates,
    function(threshold) classification_at_threshold(y, p, threshold)["balanced_accuracy"],
    numeric(1)
  )
  candidates[which.max(scores)]
}

classification_metrics <- function(y, p, threshold) {
  c(
    roc_auc = roc_auc(y, p),
    average_precision = average_precision(y, p),
    log_loss = log_loss(y, p),
    brier = brier_score(y, p),
    classification_at_threshold(y, p, threshold)
  )
}

regression_metrics <- function(y, p) {
  c(rmse = rmse(y, p), mae = mae(y, p), r_squared = r_squared(y, p))
}

baseline_formula_classifier <- positive_grade ~
  admission_grade + previous_qualification_grade + log_age +
  gender + scholarship_holder

baseline_formula_regressor <- log(grade_year1) ~
  admission_grade + previous_qualification_grade + log_age +
  gender + scholarship_holder

fit_predict_baseline <- function(training, validation) {
  classifier <- glm(
    baseline_formula_classifier,
    family = binomial(),
    data = training
  )
  positive_training <- training[training$positive_grade == 1L, ]
  regressor <- lm(baseline_formula_regressor, data = positive_training)
  smearing_factor <- mean(exp(residuals(regressor)))

  probability_positive <- clip_probability(
    predict(classifier, newdata = validation, type = "response")
  )
  conditional_grade <- pmax(
    exp(predict(regressor, newdata = validation)) * smearing_factor,
    0
  )

  list(
    p_positive = probability_positive,
    conditional_grade = conditional_grade,
    expected_grade = probability_positive * conditional_grade,
    classifier = classifier,
    regressor = regressor,
    smearing_factor = smearing_factor
  )
}

rf_predictors <- extension_features

# Manuscript Section 3.2: random-forest benchmark.

tune_random_forest <- function(
  training,
  fold_id,
  mtry_values = 1:5,
  classifier_nodesize_values = c(1L, 5L, 20L, 50L, 100L),
  regressor_nodesize_values = c(5L, 10L, 20L, 40L),
  ntree = 400L
) {
  classification_results <- data.frame()
  regression_results <- data.frame()

  for (mtry_value in mtry_values) {
    for (nodesize_value in classifier_nodesize_values) {
      class_prediction <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(training))
      for (fold in sort(unique(fold_id))) {
        analysis <- training[fold_id != fold, ]
        assessment <- training[fold_id == fold, ]
        set.seed(
          extension_seed + 100L * mtry_value + 1000L * nodesize_value + fold
        )
        classifier <- randomForest(
          x = analysis[, rf_predictors, drop = FALSE],
          y = factor(analysis$positive_grade, levels = c(0, 1)),
          ntree = ntree,
          mtry = mtry_value,
          nodesize = nodesize_value
        )
        class_prediction[fold_id == fold] <- predict(
          classifier,
          newdata = assessment[, rf_predictors, drop = FALSE],
          type = "prob"
        )[, "1"]
      }
      classification_results <- rbind(
        classification_results,
        data.frame(
          mtry = mtry_value,
          nodesize = nodesize_value,
          log_loss = log_loss(training$positive_grade, class_prediction),
          roc_auc = roc_auc(training$positive_grade, class_prediction)
        )
      )
    }
  }

  positive_rows <- training$positive_grade == 1L
  for (mtry_value in mtry_values) {
    for (nodesize_value in regressor_nodesize_values) {
      conditional_prediction <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(training))
      for (fold in sort(unique(fold_id))) {
        analysis <- training[fold_id != fold, ]
        assessment <- training[fold_id == fold, ]
        positive_analysis <- analysis[analysis$positive_grade == 1L, ]
        set.seed(
          extension_seed + 20000L + 100L * mtry_value +
            1000L * nodesize_value + fold
        )
        regressor <- randomForest(
          x = positive_analysis[, rf_predictors, drop = FALSE],
          y = positive_analysis$grade_year1,
          ntree = ntree,
          mtry = mtry_value,
          nodesize = nodesize_value
        )
        conditional_prediction[fold_id == fold] <- predict(
          regressor,
          newdata = assessment[, rf_predictors, drop = FALSE]
        )
      }
      regression_results <- rbind(
        regression_results,
        data.frame(
          mtry = mtry_value,
          nodesize = nodesize_value,
          rmse = rmse(
            training$grade_year1[positive_rows],
            conditional_prediction[positive_rows]
          )
        )
      )
    }
  }

  best_classifier_row <- which.min(classification_results$log_loss)
  best_regressor_row <- which.min(regression_results$rmse)
  list(
    classifier = classification_results,
    regressor = regression_results,
    best_classifier_mtry = classification_results$mtry[
      best_classifier_row
    ],
    best_classifier_nodesize = classification_results$nodesize[
      best_classifier_row
    ],
    best_regressor_mtry = regression_results$mtry[
      best_regressor_row
    ],
    best_regressor_nodesize = regression_results$nodesize[
      best_regressor_row
    ]
  )
}

fit_predict_random_forest <- function(
  training,
  validation,
  classifier_mtry,
  regressor_mtry,
  classifier_nodesize,
  regressor_nodesize,
  ntree = 800L,
  seed_offset = 0L
) {
  set.seed(extension_seed + 20000L + seed_offset)
  classifier <- randomForest(
    x = training[, rf_predictors, drop = FALSE],
    y = factor(training$positive_grade, levels = c(0, 1)),
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry = classifier_mtry,
    nodesize = classifier_nodesize
  )

  positive_training <- training[training$positive_grade == 1L, ]
  set.seed(extension_seed + 30000L + seed_offset)
  regressor <- randomForest(
    x = positive_training[, rf_predictors, drop = FALSE],
    y = positive_training$grade_year1,
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry = regressor_mtry,
    nodesize = regressor_nodesize
  )

  probability_positive <- clip_probability(
    predict(
      classifier,
      newdata = validation[, rf_predictors, drop = FALSE],
      type = "prob"
    )[, "1"]
  )
  conditional_grade <- pmax(
    predict(regressor, newdata = validation[, rf_predictors, drop = FALSE]),
    0
  )

  list(
    p_positive = probability_positive,
    conditional_grade = conditional_grade,
    expected_grade = probability_positive * conditional_grade,
    classifier = classifier,
    regressor = regressor
  )
}

# Manuscript Section 3.2: two-stage XGBoost design matrix and models.
xgb_matrix <- function(data) {
  matrix_out <- cbind(
    admission_grade = data$admission_grade,
    previous_qualification_grade = data$previous_qualification_grade,
    age_at_enrollment = data$age_at_enrollment,
    gender = as.numeric(as.character(data$gender)),
    scholarship_holder = as.numeric(as.character(data$scholarship_holder))
  )
  storage.mode(matrix_out) <- "double"
  matrix_out
}

xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
  eta = c(0.03, 0.08),
  max_depth = c(1L, 2L, 3L),
  min_child_weight = c(1, 8),
  subsample = c(0.8, 1.0),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

tune_xgboost <- function(
  x,
  y,
  fold_id,
  objective,
  metric,
  grid = xgb_grid,
  nrounds = 700L,
  early_stopping_rounds = 35L,
  seed_offset = 0L
) {
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(x, label = y)
  fold_list <- lapply(sort(unique(fold_id)), function(fold) which(fold_id == fold))
  tuning_results <- data.frame()

  for (row in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
    params <- list(
      objective = objective,
      eval_metric = metric,
      eta = grid$eta[row],
      max_depth = as.integer(grid$max_depth[row]),
      min_child_weight = grid$min_child_weight[row],
      subsample = grid$subsample[row],
      colsample_bytree = 1,
      nthread = 1,
      seed = as.integer(extension_seed + seed_offset + row)
    )

    set.seed(extension_seed + seed_offset + row)
    cv_fit <- xgb.cv(
      params = params,
      data = dtrain,
      nrounds = nrounds,
      folds = fold_list,
      early_stopping_rounds = early_stopping_rounds,
      maximize = FALSE,
      verbose = 0
    )
    evaluation <- as.data.frame(cv_fit$evaluation_log)
    metric_column <- paste0("test_", metric, "_mean")
    if (!metric_column %in% names(evaluation)) {
      metric_column <- grep(
        paste0("^test_", metric, ".*_mean$"),
        names(evaluation),
        value = TRUE
      )[1]
    }
    best_iteration <- which.min(evaluation[[metric_column]])
    tuning_results <- rbind(
      tuning_results,
      cbind(
        grid[row, , drop = FALSE],
        nrounds = best_iteration,
        cv_score = evaluation[[metric_column]][best_iteration]
      )
    )
  }

  best_row <- which.min(tuning_results$cv_score)
  list(
    results = tuning_results,
    best = tuning_results[best_row, , drop = FALSE]
  )
}

xgb_params_from_row <- function(best_row, objective, metric, seed) {
  list(
    objective = objective,
    eval_metric = metric,
    eta = best_row$eta,
    max_depth = as.integer(best_row$max_depth),
    min_child_weight = best_row$min_child_weight,
    subsample = best_row$subsample,
    colsample_bytree = 1,
    nthread = 1,
    seed = as.integer(seed)
  )
}

fit_predict_xgboost <- function(
  training,
  validation,
  classifier_best,
  regressor_best,
  seed_offset = 0L
) {
  x_training <- xgb_matrix(training)
  x_validation <- xgb_matrix(validation)

  classifier_params <- xgb_params_from_row(
    classifier_best,
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    metric = "logloss",
    seed = extension_seed + 40000L + seed_offset
  )
  classifier <- xgb.train(
    params = classifier_params,
    data = xgb.DMatrix(x_training, label = training$positive_grade),
    nrounds = as.integer(classifier_best$nrounds),
    verbose = 0
  )

  positive_training <- training[training$positive_grade == 1L, ]
  regressor_params <- xgb_params_from_row(
    regressor_best,
    objective = "reg:squarederror",
    metric = "rmse",
    seed = extension_seed + 50000L + seed_offset
  )
  regressor <- xgb.train(
    params = regressor_params,
    data = xgb.DMatrix(
      xgb_matrix(positive_training),
      label = positive_training$grade_year1
    ),
    nrounds = as.integer(regressor_best$nrounds),
    verbose = 0
  )

  probability_positive <- clip_probability(
    predict(classifier, xgb.DMatrix(x_validation))
  )
  conditional_grade <- pmax(
    predict(regressor, xgb.DMatrix(x_validation)),
    0
  )

  list(
    p_positive = probability_positive,
    conditional_grade = conditional_grade,
    expected_grade = probability_positive * conditional_grade,
    classifier = classifier,
    regressor = regressor
  )
}

# Manuscript Section 3.3 and Tables 3-5: fixed split, development
# cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, held-out evaluation, and bootstrap.
extension_train_index <- make_stratified_split(
  extension_data$positive_grade,
  train_prop = 0.80,
  seed = extension_seed
)
extension_train <- extension_data[extension_train_index, ]
extension_test <- extension_data[-extension_train_index, ]
extension_fold_id <- make_stratified_folds(
  extension_train$positive_grade,
  k = 5L,
  seed = extension_seed + 1L
)

# Tune each machine-learning stage using only the training set.
rf_tuning <- tune_random_forest(extension_train, extension_fold_id)

xgb_classifier_tuning <- tune_xgboost(
  x = xgb_matrix(extension_train),
  y = extension_train$positive_grade,
  fold_id = extension_fold_id,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  metric = "logloss",
  seed_offset = 100L
)

positive_train_for_tuning <- extension_train[extension_train$positive_grade == 1L, ]
positive_fold_id <- extension_fold_id[extension_train$positive_grade == 1L]
xgb_regressor_tuning <- tune_xgboost(
  x = xgb_matrix(positive_train_for_tuning),
  y = positive_train_for_tuning$grade_year1,
  fold_id = positive_fold_id,
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  metric = "rmse",
  seed_offset = 200L
)

# Five-fold out-of-fold development predictions on the 80% training sample.
cv_prediction <- data.frame(
  row_id = extension_train$row_id,
  fold = extension_fold_id,
  positive_grade = extension_train$positive_grade,
  grade_year1 = extension_train$grade_year1
)
for (model in c("Regression", "Random forest", "XGBoost")) {
  cv_prediction[[paste0(model, "__p_positive")]] <- NA_real_
  cv_prediction[[paste0(model, "__conditional")]] <- NA_real_
  cv_prediction[[paste0(model, "__expected")]] <- NA_real_
}

for (fold in seq_len(5L)) {
  analysis <- extension_train[extension_fold_id != fold, ]
  assessment <- extension_train[extension_fold_id == fold, ]
  assessment_rows <- which(extension_fold_id == fold)

  baseline_fit <- fit_predict_baseline(analysis, assessment)
  rf_fit <- fit_predict_random_forest(
    analysis,
    assessment,
    classifier_mtry = rf_tuning$best_classifier_mtry,
    regressor_mtry = rf_tuning$best_regressor_mtry,
    classifier_nodesize = rf_tuning$best_classifier_nodesize,
    regressor_nodesize = rf_tuning$best_regressor_nodesize,
    seed_offset = fold
  )
  xgb_fit <- fit_predict_xgboost(
    analysis,
    assessment,
    classifier_best = xgb_classifier_tuning$best,
    regressor_best = xgb_regressor_tuning$best,
    seed_offset = fold
  )

  cv_prediction[assessment_rows, "Regression__p_positive"] <- baseline_fit$p_positive
  cv_prediction[assessment_rows, "Regression__conditional"] <- baseline_fit$conditional_grade
  cv_prediction[assessment_rows, "Regression__expected"] <- baseline_fit$expected_grade
  cv_prediction[assessment_rows, "Random forest__p_positive"] <- rf_fit$p_positive
  cv_prediction[assessment_rows, "Random forest__conditional"] <- rf_fit$conditional_grade
  cv_prediction[assessment_rows, "Random forest__expected"] <- rf_fit$expected_grade
  cv_prediction[assessment_rows, "XGBoost__p_positive"] <- xgb_fit$p_positive
  cv_prediction[assessment_rows, "XGBoost__conditional"] <- xgb_fit$conditional_grade
  cv_prediction[assessment_rows, "XGBoost__expected"] <- xgb_fit$expected_grade
}

if (anyNA(cv_prediction)) stop("At least one cross-validation prediction is missing.")

extension_models <- c("Regression", "Random forest", "XGBoost")
extension_thresholds <- setNames(
  vapply(
    extension_models,
    function(model) choose_balanced_threshold(
      cv_prediction$positive_grade,
      cv_prediction[[paste0(model, "__p_positive")]]
    ),
    numeric(1)
  ),
  extension_models
)

# Refit each pipeline once on the full training sample and evaluate once on test.
baseline_final <- fit_predict_baseline(extension_train, extension_test)
rf_final <- fit_predict_random_forest(
  extension_train,
  extension_test,
  classifier_mtry = rf_tuning$best_classifier_mtry,
  regressor_mtry = rf_tuning$best_regressor_mtry,
  classifier_nodesize = rf_tuning$best_classifier_nodesize,
  regressor_nodesize = rf_tuning$best_regressor_nodesize,
  seed_offset = 99L
)
xgb_final <- fit_predict_xgboost(
  extension_train,
  extension_test,
  classifier_best = xgb_classifier_tuning$best,
  regressor_best = xgb_regressor_tuning$best,
  seed_offset = 99L
)

test_prediction <- data.frame(
  row_id = extension_test$row_id,
  positive_grade = extension_test$positive_grade,
  grade_year1 = extension_test$grade_year1,
  Regression__p_positive = baseline_final$p_positive,
  Regression__conditional = baseline_final$conditional_grade,
  Regression__expected = baseline_final$expected_grade,
  `Random forest__p_positive` = rf_final$p_positive,
  `Random forest__conditional` = rf_final$conditional_grade,
  `Random forest__expected` = rf_final$expected_grade,
  XGBoost__p_positive = xgb_final$p_positive,
  XGBoost__conditional = xgb_final$conditional_grade,
  XGBoost__expected = xgb_final$expected_grade,
  check.names = FALSE
)

collect_metrics <- function(prediction_data, data_split, thresholds) {
  output <- data.frame()
  positive_rows <- prediction_data$positive_grade == 1L
  for (model in extension_models) {
    class_values <- classification_metrics(
      prediction_data$positive_grade,
      prediction_data[[paste0(model, "__p_positive")]],
      thresholds[[model]]
    )
    conditional_values <- regression_metrics(
      prediction_data$grade_year1[positive_rows],
      prediction_data[[paste0(model, "__conditional")]][positive_rows]
    )
    overall_values <- regression_metrics(
      prediction_data$grade_year1,
      prediction_data[[paste0(model, "__expected")]]
    )
    output <- rbind(
      output,
      data.frame(
        split = data_split,
        model = model,
        component = "Classifier",
        metric = names(class_values),
        value = as.numeric(class_values)
      ),
      data.frame(
        split = data_split,
        model = model,
        component = "Conditional positive-grade regressor",
        metric = names(conditional_values),
        value = as.numeric(conditional_values)
      ),
      data.frame(
        split = data_split,
        model = model,
        component = "Overall expected grade",
        metric = names(overall_values),
        value = as.numeric(overall_values)
      )
    )
  }
  output
}

extension_metrics <- rbind(
  collect_metrics(cv_prediction, "Five-fold CV", extension_thresholds),
  collect_metrics(test_prediction, "Held-out test", extension_thresholds)
)

cv_fold_metrics <- data.frame()
for (fold in seq_len(5L)) {
  fold_data <- cv_prediction[cv_prediction$fold == fold, ]
  fold_metrics <- collect_metrics(fold_data, paste0("CV fold ", fold), extension_thresholds)
  cv_fold_metrics <- rbind(cv_fold_metrics, fold_metrics)
}

cv_summary <- aggregate(
  value ~ model + component + metric,
  data = cv_fold_metrics,
  FUN = function(x) c(mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x))
)
cv_summary <- data.frame(
  model = cv_summary$model,
  component = cv_summary$component,
  metric = cv_summary$metric,
  mean = cv_summary$value[, "mean"],
  sd = cv_summary$value[, "sd"]
)

paired_bootstrap_difference <- function(
  observed,
  xgb_prediction,
  comparator_prediction,
  statistic = c("rmse", "mae"),
  replicates = 2000L,
  seed = extension_seed + 60000L
) {
  statistic <- match.arg(statistic)
  metric_function <- if (statistic == "rmse") rmse else mae
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- length(observed)
  differences <- replicate(replicates, {
    rows <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    metric_function(observed[rows], xgb_prediction[rows]) -
      metric_function(observed[rows], comparator_prediction[rows])
  })
  c(
    difference = metric_function(observed, xgb_prediction) -
      metric_function(observed, comparator_prediction),
    lower_95 = unname(quantile(differences, 0.025)),
    upper_95 = unname(quantile(differences, 0.975))
  )
}

bootstrap_comparisons <- data.frame()
for (comparator in c("Regression", "Random forest")) {
  for (statistic in c("rmse", "mae")) {
    difference <- paired_bootstrap_difference(
      observed = test_prediction$grade_year1,
      xgb_prediction = test_prediction$XGBoost__expected,
      comparator_prediction = test_prediction[[paste0(comparator, "__expected")]],
      statistic = statistic,
      seed = extension_seed + 60000L + which(extension_models == comparator) * 10L +
        which(c("rmse", "mae") == statistic)
    )
    bootstrap_comparisons <- rbind(
      bootstrap_comparisons,
      data.frame(
        comparator = comparator,
        metric = statistic,
        difference_xgboost_minus_comparator = difference["difference"],
        lower_95 = difference["lower_95"],
        upper_95 = difference["upper_95"]
      )
    )
  }
}

# Manuscript Sections 3.4 and 4.4, Table 6 and Figure 2: SHAP values on the
# untouched test set. Classifier SHAP is on the log-odds scale; regressor SHAP
# is on the original conditional grade scale.
x_test_matrix <- xgb_matrix(extension_test)
classifier_shap <- predict(
  xgb_final$classifier,
  xgb.DMatrix(x_test_matrix),
  predcontrib = TRUE
)
positive_test_rows <- extension_test$positive_grade == 1L
regressor_shap <- predict(
  xgb_final$regressor,
  xgb.DMatrix(x_test_matrix[positive_test_rows, , drop = FALSE]),
  predcontrib = TRUE
)

shap_feature_names <- colnames(x_test_matrix)
colnames(classifier_shap) <- c(shap_feature_names, "BIAS")
colnames(regressor_shap) <- c(shap_feature_names, "BIAS")

shap_importance <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    stage = "Classifier (log-odds)",
    feature = shap_feature_names,
    mean_absolute_shap = colMeans(abs(classifier_shap[, shap_feature_names, drop = FALSE]))
  ),
  data.frame(
    stage = "Conditional regressor (grade points)",
    feature = shap_feature_names,
    mean_absolute_shap = colMeans(abs(regressor_shap[, shap_feature_names, drop = FALSE]))
  )
)

quantile_shap_summary <- function(feature_values, shap_values, bins = 10L) {
  breaks <- unique(quantile(
    feature_values,
    probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = bins + 1L),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    type = 8
  ))
  if (length(breaks) < 3L) {
    return(data.frame(
      bin = as.character(feature_values),
      n = as.integer(table(feature_values)[as.character(feature_values)]),
      mean_feature = feature_values,
      mean_shap = shap_values
    ))
  }
  group <- cut(feature_values, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, ordered_result = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    bin = levels(group),
    n = as.numeric(table(group)),
    mean_feature = as.numeric(tapply(feature_values, group, mean)),
    mean_shap = as.numeric(tapply(shap_values, group, mean))
  )
}

shap_dependence_summary <- data.frame()
for (feature in c(
  "admission_grade",
  "previous_qualification_grade",
  "age_at_enrollment"
)) {
  stage1_summary <- quantile_shap_summary(
    x_test_matrix[, feature],
    classifier_shap[, feature]
  )
  stage1_summary$stage <- "Classifier (log-odds)"
  stage1_summary$feature <- feature

  stage2_summary <- quantile_shap_summary(
    x_test_matrix[positive_test_rows, feature],
    regressor_shap[, feature]
  )
  stage2_summary$stage <- "Conditional regressor (grade points)"
  stage2_summary$feature <- feature

  shap_dependence_summary <- rbind(
    shap_dependence_summary,
    stage1_summary,
    stage2_summary
  )
}

shap_binary_summary <- data.frame()
for (feature in c("gender", "scholarship_holder")) {
  for (level in c(0, 1)) {
    stage1_rows <- x_test_matrix[, feature] == level
    stage2_values <- x_test_matrix[positive_test_rows, feature]
    stage2_rows <- stage2_values == level
    shap_binary_summary <- rbind(
      shap_binary_summary,
      data.frame(
        stage = "Classifier (log-odds)",
        feature = feature,
        level = level,
        n = sum(stage1_rows),
        mean_shap = mean(classifier_shap[stage1_rows, feature])
      ),
      data.frame(
        stage = "Conditional regressor (grade points)",
        feature = feature,
        level = level,
        n = sum(stage2_rows),
        mean_shap = mean(regressor_shap[stage2_rows, feature])
      )
    )
  }
}

# Manuscript Figure 1: held-out predictive performance.
png(

# Manuscript Figure 2: test-set SHAP dependence for continuous predictors.
png(
  file.path(extension_output_dir, "shap_dependence.png"),

)
par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1))
for (stage in c("Classifier", "Regressor")) {

    "admission_grade",

  )) {
    if (stage == "Classifier") {
      x_values <- x_test_matrix[, feature]

    } else {
      x_values <- x_test_matrix[positive_test_rows, feature]

    plot(
      x_values,

      xlab = gsub("_", " ", feature),

      main = paste(stage, "-", gsub("_", " ", feature))
    )
    lines(lowess(x_values, y_values, f = 0.55), col = "#C44536", lwd = 3)
    abline(h = 0, lty = 3, col = "grey50")
  }
}
